## Observed results

Mark only checks you actually performed. Leave untested items unchecked.

- [ ] Import completed and the format/scale/suffix rows match the preset table.
- [ ] Artboard-based filenames and scale suffixes are correct.
- [ ] Raster dimensions match the intended base size and scale.
- [ ] Transparency, colors, text and clipping were inspected.
- [ ] Underscore pages were excluded manually from the asset pass.
- [ ] PDF Only with Single File produced the intended page count/order.

## Exact setup and output

Describe the selected artboards, base dimensions, format settings, output filenames and dimensions. Use the `_Cover`, `Logo`, `_Notes` test from docs/VALIDATION.md or explain your test document. Mention unavailable formats and any manual corrections.

## Problems or untested items

State what failed or was not tested. A successful test applies only to the recorded environment and presets.

Do not attach private client artwork, local filesystem paths or font files. Use a disposable example for screenshots.
